verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair privacy-posture question for a hosted model API, so the axis applies. However, no item in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, residency controls, or regional endpoints. The cited docs cover text generation, tools, batch, caching, fine-tuning and API-key administration, none of which address where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
